title: Kickin' Rice
description: Bring extra flavor to a simple rice side dish by using chicken broth instead of water and adding green chile peppers.

steps.text: Heat vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir rice in hot oil until coated; add green chiles and continue cooking until rice begins to brown lightly, 2 to 3 minutes. Season rice with pepper. Pour broth into the saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, place cover on the saucepan, and cook until the broth is absorbed and the rice tender, about 20 minutes.

video.description: When it comes to side dishes, it doesn’t get any more reliable than rice, but sometimes rice needs a pick me up, and that’s where this recipe comes in handy. In this video, learn how to make rice more tasty and interesting with the simple addition of chicken broth and green chile peppers. Serve this versatile side with almost any main course, or you can eat it with nothing else for a quick and easy snack.
